name: Antagonistic Dual-Wavelength Optimization
definition: An optimization workflow that trains inhibition projector patterns against fixed activation projector patterns to achieve a target volumetric polymerization state. The loss is evaluated on the effective volume resulting from the antagonistic interaction of two wavelengths.
summary: Antagonistic Dual-Wavelength Optimization is a volumetric manufacturing training method that synthesizes inhibition patterns against fixed activation patterns to define an effective volume, differing from general radiance-field optimization by explicitly modeling two distinct wavelengths.
